comparisons.reason: Same source column (argument), but the annotation functions differ. Feature 0 requires an explicit admission of uncertainty or fallibility about the OP's own view, and excludes text in marked edits that was added after posting. Feature 1 counts any hedging marker ('maybe', 'perhaps', 'might', 'possibly', hedging 'I think'), which is much broader, and says to include the whole argument text, edits included. Rows with only a hedge word, or with an uncertainty statement only in an edit, would be scored differently.
